decisions.bindingProductRule: Use required Family Court proposed order Form 283 (Rev 6/20), held on page 15 of Form 1021IP (Rev 10/23). Keep Form 281, conditional 281E and Form 283 in filing order, followed by the participant-supplied SBI cover letter and certified criminal history; retain the separate assembly guide. Family Court adult expungement filing is $0 under the Schedule of Assessed Costs effective July 20, 2026. Its page 2 specific expungement exemption expressly includes archive and court-security costs and controls the generic page 3 security list that still names adult expungement; preserve this discrepancy and the source-specific exception in the record. This is separate from criminal-history acquisition costs and outstanding conviction obligations under § 4372(l); do not condition that provision on inability to pay a $0 filing fee or waive restitution. Section 10  of 85 Del. Laws, c. 142 replaces the § 4374(e) victim address/telephone contact requirement with contact under § 9414(a); the § 9401 victim definition and the other inspected service, criminal-history and 120-day duties remain. Do not manufacture signatures, judicial findings or other court-owned entries on Form 283.
